title: Owner visual check on phone and desktop
goal: The owner confirms the graph reads right in Eva and Simple
acceptance: Copy-paste: after the update, run `nerv open dashboard --print`, open the link on the Mac and the phone, ask NERV a question, expect the path to light with a reason on every hop; switch Settings, Theme between Eva and Simple; reply "ok" or what looks wrong
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
